name: Area71 RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 36.6072,-93.5676: gravel RV loops in oak woods off State Hwy YY above Shell Knob; Table Rock Lake is not in the frame; not waterfront

name: Broken Arrow Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame, leaf-off) at 37.1519,-91.3556: campground loops on the flat inside a Jacks Fork bend at the east edge of Eminence; the NE loop runs within ~50 m of the river behind a thin tree line on the bank, most loops sit 100-250 m back; operator's tipis are 'right on the river' but RV pads at the water's edge aren't confirmed; riverview

name: I-49 RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 38.4862,-94.3427: a gravel pull-through lot beside I-49 with a small stormwater-size pond off its SE corner; only a corner pad or two sits near it, the lot reads as a highway stop; not waterfront

name: Pontiac Cove Marina & Lake Harbour Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame, leaf-off) at 36.5090,-92.6096: sites scattered under open oaks on a bluff-top point of Norfork Lake above the marina cove, the lake on three sides 30-80 m away and below a rocky bluff; no pads at the water's edge; lakeview

name: Roaring River Hills Campground & Cabins
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 36.6195,-93.8512: a paved pull-in loop on open pasture behind the office on Hwy 112, a small farm pond south of the loop ~40 m off the nearest pads; not waterfront

name: Sinking Creek Ranch
evidence: satellite (Esri, 1200 m frame) at 37.4893,-91.3076: imagery predates the campground - only a farmhouse, pasture and the creek corridor to the north are visible, no pads; operator calls the pads 'creekside' but nothing can be confirmed; defaults down; not waterfront (recheck on newer imagery)

name: Papa Chubby's Lakeside Resort
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame, leaf-off) at 38.1183,-92.7396: the main RV rows sit on a graded hillside 200-300 m west of the cove, a second cluster of rigs lines the cove's west shore ~20-50 m from the water near the marina; mixed long-stay units make the at-water pads unconfirmed as RV sites; lakeview
